name: guardrails
description: Guards for Claude Code tool calls: blocks destructive shell commands, asks before destructive git and settings edits, masks Bash reads of secret files, blocks the Read tool on them and asks before writes to them, blocks oversized whole-file Reads, and notes re-reads and retry loops.

disabled_guards.title: Disabled guard families
disabled_guards.description: Comma-separated families to turn off: pii, raw-client-data, session-url, egress, git. Every guard is on when this is empty. The core blocks (rm -rf of home or root, git push --force, dd, fork bombs) cannot be turned off.

allowed_email_domains.title: Your email addresses or domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Comma-separated addresses or @domains the egress guard treats as yours, such as @example.com. The domain of your global git user.email always counts.

fail_open.title: Allow tool calls when the guard binary is missing
fail_open.description: By default a tool call is blocked, with a message saying how to retry, when the guard binary is not installed (a failed download or checksum). Turn this on to let tool calls through unguarded instead.

client_data_buckets.title: Client-data S3 buckets
client_data_buckets.description: Comma-separated S3 bucket names that hold raw client data; * matches any run of characters, for example *-clientdata. The raw-client-data guard asks before Python reads s3://<bucket>/... Empty means no buckets.

masked_copy_dirs.title: Masked-copy directories
masked_copy_dirs.description: Comma-separated directories that hold masked copies of client data, for example ~/.cache/masked/. The raw-client-data guard does not ask about parquet paths under them. Empty means no exemption.

handoff_tokens.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
handoff_tokens.description: Context size at which the Stop gate asks Claude, once per session, to write a handoff. Leave empty for 80% of CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (240000 for the default 300000 window).

aws_session_tag.title: Tag AWS calls with the session id
aws_session_tag.description: Off by default. When on, each session sets AWS_SDK_UA_APP_ID=claude-<first 8 characters of the session id>, so AWS CLI and SDK calls made from Bash carry it in their User-Agent and CloudTrail records which session made them.

rtk.title: Rewrite commands with RTK
rtk.description: Off by default. When on, the pre-tool-use hook runs `rtk hook claude` after its own checks and applies RTK's token-saving command rewrite. Needs RTK installed. Do not also install RTK's own Claude Code hook.

rtk_command.title: RTK command or path
rtk_command.description: The rtk executable to run when the rtk option is on. Empty means `rtk` from PATH.
